notes: Maine high-school athletes only. TFRRS compiled results, overall place among all entrants. Rows entered Unattached or under a club/other team (marked unattached:true) were filed under the Maine school found by name in our athlete index for that season (a single match); club teams as printed include Maine Race Walkers and others.
